question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Cheerless


(Constable GD Examination 2022)
options: Bright
Strong
Gloomy
Clear
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Gloomy

Cheerless - Gloomy

Explanation:
"Gloomy" is the correct synonym for "cheerless" because both words describe a lack of happiness or brightness, often associated with sadness or dullness.
"ग्लूमी" और "चीयरलेस" दोनों शब्द उदासी या नीरसता से जुड़े हैं, जो खुशी या चमक की कमी को दर्शाते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
Dreary, Dismal, Bleak, Morose, Somber

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Cheerless – निराशाजनक – (Lacking happiness or comfort; dreary)
Example: "The abandoned house had a cheerless atmosphere."

Bright – चमकीला – (Full of light; shining)
Example: "The bright sun made the day warm and pleasant."

Strong – मजबूत – (Having physical power or resilience)
Example: "He was strong enough to lift the heavy box."

Clear – स्पष्ट – (Easy to perceive or understand)
Example: "Her instructions were clear and easy to follow."

Gloomy – उदास – (Dark or poorly lit; depressing)
Example: "The gloomy weather matched his sad mood."

Conclusion:
"Gloomy" is the best synonym for "cheerless" as both convey a sense of sadness and dullness, unlike the other options which suggest brightness, strength, or clarity.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Cherish
(Constable GD Examination 2022)
options: Neglect
Condemn
Abandon
Admire
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Admire

Cherish - Admire

Explanation:
"Cherish" means to hold something dear or to value it deeply, and "admire" aligns closely as it means to regard with respect or warm approval. Both words involve positive feelings toward someone or something.
"चाहना" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को प्रिय मानना या गहराई से महत्व देना, और "प्रशंसा करना" इसके करीब है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है सम्मान या गर्मजोशी से स्वीकृति देना। दोनों शब्दों में किसी के प्रति सकारात्मक भावना शामिल है।

Other synonyms Words:
Treasure, Value, Esteem, Prize, Hold dear

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Cherish – प्यार करना – To hold something dear or to protect lovingly.
Example: "She will always cherish the memories of her childhood."

Neglect – उपेक्षा करना – To fail to care for properly.
Example: "He neglected his duties and faced consequences."

Condemn – निंदा करना – To express strong disapproval.
Example: "The court condemned his actions as unlawful."

Abandon – त्यागना – To leave completely or give up.
Example: "They had to abandon the sinking ship."

Admire – प्रशंसा करना – To regard with respect or approval.
Example: "I admire her dedication to her work."

Conclusion:
"Admire" is the best synonym for "cherish" as both involve positive regard, while the other options (neglect, condemn, abandon) convey negative meanings.

question:

Chide
(Combined Graduate Level Examination Tier I 2022)
options: Rescue
Prevent
Follow
Scold
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Scold

Chide - Scold

Explanation:
"Chide" means to scold or rebuke someone mildly. "Scold" is the most appropriate synonym as it also means to reprimand or criticize someone.
"चिड़ाना" का अर्थ है किसी को हल्के-फुल्के ढंग से डांटना। "Scold" सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी किसी को फटकारना या आलोचना करना है।

Other synonyms Words:
Rebuke, Reprimand, Admonish, Berate, Censure

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Chide – डांटना – To scold or rebuke someone mildly.
Example: "She chided her son for forgetting his homework."

Rescue – बचाव – To save someone from danger.
Example: "The firefighters rescued the family from the burning building."

Prevent – रोकना – To stop something from happening.
Example: "Vaccination helps prevent diseases."

Follow – पालन करना – To go or come after someone.
Example: "Please follow the instructions carefully."

Scold – डांटना – To reprimand or criticize someone angrily.
Example: "The teacher scolded the students for being noisy."

Conclusion:
"Scold" is the best synonym for "Chide" because both words convey the act of reprimanding someone, though "Chide" is milder. The other options do not relate to the meaning of "Chide."

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

An inch taller than I, he had a lean, muscular frame, clear blue eyes, blond hair and a strikingly handsome and chiselled face.
(SSA UDC 2023 and 2024 Paper I)
options: Defined
Asymmetric
Carved
Irregular
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Carved

Strikingly handsome and chiselled - Carved

Explanation:
The word "chiselled" refers to a sharply defined, well-shaped facial structure, often resembling something sculpted or carved. "Carved" is the most accurate synonym as it conveys the same meaning of precision and sharpness.
"चीज़ल्ड" का अर्थ है तीखी और सुडौल चेहरे की संरचना, जो मूर्तिकला या नक्काशी जैसी दिखती है। "Carved" सबसे सटीक समानार्थी शब्द है क्योंकि यह सटीकता और तीखेपन का वही अर्थ व्यक्त करता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Sculpted, Defined, Sharp, Angular, Well-proportioned

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Chiselled – नक्काशीदार – Having a sharply defined, well-shaped structure, especially facial features.
Example: "His chiselled jawline made him look like a Greek god."

Defined – स्पष्ट – Clearly outlined or distinct.
Example: "Her muscles were well-defined after months of training."

Asymmetric – असममित – Lacking symmetry; uneven.
Example: "The artist preferred asymmetric designs in his paintings."

Irregular – अनियमित – Not uniform or consistent.
Example: "The coastline had an irregular shape with many inlets."

Carved – तराशा हुआ – Shaped by cutting or sculpting.
Example: "The statue had a beautifully carved face with intricate details."

Conclusion:
"Carved" is the best synonym for "chiselled" because both imply a sharp, well-sculpted appearance, particularly in facial features. The other options either do not fit the context or suggest unevenness rather than precision.

question:
Refer to the below poem and answer the questions.
Aunt Jennifer’s tigers prance across a screen,
Bright topaz denizens of a world of green.
They do not fear the men beneath the tree;
They pace in sleek chivalric certainty.

Aunt Jennifer’s fingers fluttering through her wool
Find even the ivory needle hard to pull.
The massive weight of Uncle’s wedding band
Sits heavily upon Aunt Jennifer’s hand.

When Aunt is dead, her terrified hands will lie
Still ringed with ordeals she was mastered by.
The tigers in the panel that she made
Will go on prancing, proud and unafraid.Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word below.
Chivalry
(Junior Teacher (Schematic) CATEGORY ll (Science))
options: Vulgarity
Rudeness
Manners
Impoliteness
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Manners

Chivalry - Manners

Explanation:
"Chivalry" refers to courteous behavior, especially that of a man toward women, synonymous with politeness and good manners.
"चिवेलरी" शिष्टाचार, विशेषकर पुरुषों द्वारा महिलाओं के प्रति दिखाए गए विनम्र व्यवहार को दर्शाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Courtesy, Gallantry, Nobility, Politeness, Gentility

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Chivalry – शिष्टाचार – Courteous behavior, especially that of a man toward women.
Example: "He opened the door for her, a gesture of old-fashioned chivalry."

Vulgarity – अशिष्टता – Lack of sophistication or good taste; rudeness.
Example: "His speech was full of vulgarity and crude jokes."

Rudeness – असभ्यता – Lack of manners; impoliteness.
Example: "His rudeness offended everyone at the dinner table."

Manners – शिष्टाचार – Polite or well-bred social behavior.
Example: "Good manners are essential for making a positive impression."

Impoliteness – अशिष्टता – Lack of courtesy; rudeness.
Example: "Her impoliteness made the guests uncomfortable."

Conclusion:
"Manners" is the most appropriate synonym for "chivalry" as both signify courteous and polite behavior, unlike the other options which represent rudeness or lack of refinement.

question:
Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word.

Choke
(Constable GD 2021)
options: Hack
Block
Slash
Chop
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Block

Choke - Block

Explanation:
"Choke" means to obstruct or block a passage, making it difficult to breathe or flow. "Block" is the correct synonym as it also means to obstruct or stop the movement of something.
"चोक" का अर्थ है किसी मार्ग को अवरुद्ध करना, जिससे सांस लेना या प्रवाह मुश्किल हो जाए। "ब्लॉक" सही पर्याय है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी किसी चीज़ के प्रवाह को रोकना है।

Other synonyms Words:
Obstruct, Strangle, Suffocate, Throttle, Clog

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Choke – दम घोंटना – To prevent someone from breathing by constricting the throat.
Example: "The smoke made him choke."

Hack – काटना – To cut roughly or chop.
Example: "He used an axe to hack the wood."

Slash – काटना – To cut with a sweeping motion.
Example: "She slashed the rope with a knife."

Chop – काटना – To cut into pieces with repeated blows.
Example: "He chopped the vegetables finely."

Block – अवरुद्ध करना – To obstruct or stop movement.
Example: "The fallen tree blocked the road."

Conclusion:
"Block" is the most appropriate synonym for "choke" because both words imply obstruction or stopping the flow of something, whereas the other options relate to cutting actions.

question:

Choosy
(Constable GD 2021)
options: Precious
Boring
Critical
Picky
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Picky

Choosy - Picky

Explanation:
"Choosy" means being very careful or selective in making choices, and "Picky" is a direct synonym that conveys the same meaning. Both words imply a tendency to be overly selective or fussy.
["Choosy" का अर्थ है चयन करने में बहुत सावधान या चुनिंदा होना, और "Picky" इसका सीधा समानार्थी शब्द है जो समान अर्थ व्यक्त करता है। दोनों शब्द अत्यधिक चयनात्मक या नखरेबाज होने की प्रवृत्ति दर्शाते हैं।]

Other synonyms Words:
Fussy, Finicky, Selective, Particular, Fastidious

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Choosy – चुनिंदा / नखरेबाज – (Very careful or selective in making choices)
Example: "She is very choosy about the clothes she wears."

Precious – कीमती / बहुमूल्य – (Of great value or high price)
Example: "Gold is a precious metal."

Boring – उबाऊ – (Not interesting or exciting)
Example: "The lecture was so boring that many students fell asleep."

Critical – आलोचनात्मक / नाजुक – (Expressing disapproval or being crucial)
Example: "She was critical of his careless attitude."

Picky – नखरेबाज / चुनिंदा – (Hard to please; very selective)
Example: "He is picky about the food he eats."

Conclusion:
"Picky" is the best synonym for "Choosy" because both words describe someone who is overly selective or hard to please. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

solution:

संयोग से घटित होने वाली घटना को "Coincidence" कहते हैं, और "Chance" इसका सही पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि यह भी बिना इरादे के होने वाली घटना को दर्शाता है।

[Coincidence] – संयोग – An occurrence of events that happen at the same time by accident but seem to have a connection.
Example: "Running into my old friend in a foreign country was a strange coincidence."

[Extent] – सीमा – The degree or scope of something.
Example: "The extent of the damage caused by the storm was enormous."

Example: "The argument was just a minor incident and was quickly forgotten."

[Chance] – संयोग / अवसर – Something that happens unpredictably without an apparent cause.
Example: "Meeting her at the café was pure chance."

Conclusion:
"Chance" is the best synonym for "Coincidence" because both words describe events that occur without deliberate planning or intention. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:

Our company wants to collaborate with your team.
(MTS Non technical and Havaldar Examination 2021)
options: Captivate
Defy
Collude
Repel
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Collude

Collaborate - Collude

Explanation:
"Collaborate" means to work together on a project or task, and "collude" also implies working together, though often secretly or for a deceitful purpose. While "collude" has a negative connotation, it is the closest synonym among the given options.
सहयोग करना और मिलीभगत करना दोनों का अर्थ है साथ काम करना, हालांकि मिलीभगत में धोखाधड़ी का भाव होता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Cooperate, Unite, Partner, Team up, Join forces

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Collaborate – सहयोग करना – To work jointly on an activity or project.
Example: "Scientists from different countries collaborated on the research project."

Captivate – मोहित करना – To attract and hold the interest of someone.
Example: "The magician's performance captivated the audience."

Defy – अवज्ञा करना – To openly resist or refuse to obey.
Example: "The protesters defied the government's orders."

Repel – दूर भगाना – To drive or force back.
Example: "The army repelled the enemy's attack."

Collude – मिलीभगत करना – To conspire or cooperate secretly for a deceitful purpose.
Example: "The two companies were accused of colluding to fix prices."

Conclusion:
"Collude" is the most appropriate synonym among the given options because it conveys the idea of working together, even if it carries a negative implication. The other words do not match the meaning of "collaborate."
